description: The slopped.site sites hide secrets. Give the first, vaguest rung of one secret’s hint ladder, never the answer or the later hints: the rest is for the visitor to find (the codex’s secrets ledger reveals the next rungs one at a time). With no id, lists every secret’s title and site. Use when someone is hunting and wants a nudge.

id.description: The secret’s two-letter id (leave out to list them).

name: secret_hint
title: A first hint for a secret
